name: Player Auto-Elevation Snap & Velocity Cancel
description: Active player anti-fall safeguard that monitors player Y coordinates during block breaks. If the player dips below y=65.1 while standing on the breaking block, it immediately snaps their vertical position back to y=65.0 and invokes clearVelocity() to freeze downward falling momentum.

implementation.script_logic: const pLoc = player.location; if (Math.abs(pLoc.x - 0.5) < 0.9 && Math.abs(pLoc.z - 0.5) < 0.9 && pLoc.y < 65.1 && pLoc.y >= 63.8) { system.run(() => { try { player.teleport({ x: pLoc.x, y: 65.0, z: pLoc.z }, { dimension: dimension, checkForBlocks: false }); player.clearVelocity(); } catch (err) {} }); }
